tools.name: es_aggregate
tools.description: Aggregate log records by a categorical field.

group_by.description: Categorical field to group by (level, service, or status_code).

tools.name: es_search
tools.description: Search log records, optionally filtered by log level.

query_level.description: Optional log level to filter by (e.g. ERROR, WARN, INFO).

size.description: Maximum number of hits to return.

tools.name: field_stats
tools.description: Summary statistics for a single field across all log records.

field.description: Field to summarise (duration_ms, status_code, level, service, message).
